visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair sits in a black ergonomic chair, wearing a white T-shirt and blue shorts, holding a book with a blue and white cover. A young girl with long dark hair and bangs rushes into the frame from the left, looking panicked and pointing back toward the door. (2) The scene cuts to the man and girl huddled together behind a light beige door, appearing frightened and whispering. The lighting is soft and warm within the indoor room setting. The man reaches out with his right hand to slowly push open the heavy white door. (3) The door swings open to reveal a young boy standing in the hallway, wearing a pink lace-trimmed dress and a short black bob-style wig. He has exceptionally thick, exaggerated black eyebrows drawn onto his forehead and red circular marks on his cheeks, staring directly at the camera with a stern, angry expression. (4) The boy suddenly lets out a loud scream, throwing his hands up in fists. The man jumps back in theatrical fear, holding his hands up to protect himself. Graphic lightning and flame effects surround the boy to emphasize his 'angry' persona. (5) A woman with dark hair tied back appears next to the boy, smiling warmly at the camera. She is wearing a black T-shirt and denim shorts. The setting remains the same indoor hallway with neutral-toned walls and soft artificial lighting. (6) A series of quick cuts shows the boy bothering the woman in different scenarios: he screams while she tries to sleep, he sits on her back while she mops the floor, and he stands between her and the man during a conversation. (7) The woman stands in front of a closed white door, holding a small red rectangular box labeled 'Okasang'. She points at the box with a cheerful expression, presenting it as a solution to her previous troubles. (8) On a white table, several red boxes of the product are lined up. The woman tears open a small red sachet and pours a dark, viscous brown liquid into a small clear glass. A circular inset shows a close-up of dried red dates. (9) The woman takes a sip from the glass, then smiles and looks refreshed. Yellow star-shaped sparkles and light flares appear around her to signify a positive physical effect. (10) The man, woman, and two children are now sitting together on a beige sofa. They are all holding small glasses and drinking the red date extract. The 'Auntie' boy is still in his dress but looks calm and happy. (11) The man gives a thumbs up. Suddenly, the boy pulls off his black wig, revealing his short natural hair and laughing. The man looks shocked and then laughs along with the others as the scene fades out.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy pop music with a bright synth melody and a driving drum beat begins immediately. A young girl's high-pitched, excited voice yells 'He's coming!' followed by a 'Whoosh' transition SFX. (2) A low, percussive 'Thud' sound mimics a door slamming shut. The music continues with a playful, bouncy tempo. A man's voice is heard speaking in a worried, hushed tone, quickly followed by the sound of a door clicking open. (3) A loud, distorted comedic scream from a child bursts through the mix, accompanied by a sharp 'Impact' SFX. The BGM gains a slightly heavier bass line to match the 'angry' visual energy. (4) The mother's voice takes over, delivering a clear, professional, yet friendly narration. The BGM shifts slightly to a clean acoustic guitar strumming pattern at roughly 124 BPM. (5) A series of 'Whoosh' and 'Pop' SFX punctuate the fast visual montage. The boy's voice is heard intermittently groaning or shouting in an exaggerated, comedic manner. (6) Sound of a plastic sachet being torn open, followed by a detailed 'Pouring' sound of liquid hitting a glass with high spectral clarity. A bright 'Ding' bell SFX highlights the product's finish. (7) Relaxing, positive musical cues with a sparkling 'Magic' SFX layer in as the woman drinks. Her voice sounds calm and satisfied. (8) The final sequence features a mix of friendly group chatter and child laughter. A comedic 'Boing' SFX triggers when the wig is pulled off, followed by a loud, hearty male laugh as the music concludes with a bright flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit to personify menstrual discomfort as a terrifying 'Auntie' (played by a boy in a wig) to promote 'Okasang Red Dates Extract'. By showing the transformation from a chaotic period experience to a peaceful, healthy state after using the product, it appeals to female viewers seeking relief and wellness.
